mechanism: Prosus receives most look-through value from Tencent's games, attention, advertising and consumer-services ecosystem plus private ecommerce platforms; the benefit reaches PRX shareholders through NAV, private-asset cash flow and repurchases executed below NAV.
catalyst: Tencent and private-platform value or cash flow grows, ecommerce profitability broadens, net debt remains controlled, transparent NAV persists and discounted-share repurchases continue to increase NAV per share.
invalidation: Tencent or private-platform economics deteriorate materially; ecosystem exposure becomes immaterial after debt; governance or cross-holding complexity prevents value transmission; net debt rises; repurchases lose accretion; or the holding-company discount widens persistently despite operating value creation.
